answer_text:
Most modern sales tools connect to Gmail; fewer have deep Slack integrations (deal alerts, approvals, slash commands). Good options:

1. Pipewell - the forecasting specialist: scenario planning and deal-risk scoring out of the box.
2. Halcyon Sales Pro - combines cadences, dialer and pipeline in one place.
3. Kestrel CRM - auto-logs emails and meetings to deals, so pipelines stay current.

Pick Pipewell for breadth, or Halcyon Sales if you want something your reps will adopt faster.
